Container.Name: spamfilter-redis
Container.Overview: Redis persistence backend for the IMAP spam filter stack. Stores rspamd Bayes tokens, fuzzy hashes, and neural weights. AOF + RDB enabled so the corpus survives container restarts. Install on the spamnet network alongside spamfilter-rspamd, spamfilter-unbound, and spamfilter.
Container.Requires: Run unraid/bootstrap.sh first: it creates `spamnet`, the appdata layout, and the mode-0640 Redis config. The container keeps Redis uid 999 and uses appdata group 100 so the official image can read that protected config.

Config.Name: Data dir
Config.Description: Redis AOF/RDB files. Critical to back up - losing this means retraining Bayes from zero.

Config.Name: Server config dir
Config.Description: Directory holding the bootstrap-rendered redis.conf (persistence, memory cap, requirepass auth). Read-only. Run bootstrap.sh before installing.
